name: shambling mound
desc: Shambling Mound is a CR 5 plant.

actions.name: lightning absorption
actions.desc: Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .lOIA9YKQU8xSx7Lj]]{slam} attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is &reference[grappled] escape DC 14, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses its [[/item .N42BQALoCmeYphD1]]{Engulf} on it.

actions.name: engulf
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} engulfs a Medium or smaller creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by it. The engulfed target is &reference[blinded], &reference[restrained], and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a [[/save activity=qxYtQIpEbpMrFvVe]] saving throw at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns or take [[/damage average activity=qxYtQIpEbpMrFvVe]] damage. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature engulfed at a time.
